==Copyright violations==
Please stop copying content from [[Encyclopaedia WoT]]! You may not copy their web pages into an editor and simply reformat and add more detail.  That is a derivative work and hence plagiarism.  To contribute summaries to this wiki you must begin writing them FROM SCRATCH, in YOUR OWN WORDS, or have permission from the original author to copy their work under the [[Wikipedia:GFDL|GFDL]] license.
If you keep using content from EWoT I will be forced to block your account. You may only use EWoT as a reference too look up factual information.

If you need help understanding this, please think about writing a research paper for school.  You don't simply copy an article from an encyclopedia and start reformatting, restructuring, and adding detail.  You have to start from scratch!

Also, when you write a complete summary, do not include <nowiki>{{chapter-stub}}</nowiki> at the bottom.

Thanks. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 20:30, 21 May 2007 (UTC)
